name: Airlie Beach (Whitsundays)
tagline: Gateway to Whitehaven Beach and the reef
summary: Airlie Beach is the lively launch point for the Whitsunday Islands. Sail to the pure white silica sand of Whitehaven Beach and the swirling Hill Inlet lookout, snorkel the Great Barrier Reef, fly over Heart Reef, and swim in the town's lagoon pool while stinger season keeps you out of the sea.
seasonNote: Dry winter June to October; stinger season November to May (wear a stinger suit).
arrival: Fly to Proserpine (35 minutes away) or Hamilton Island.
gettingAround: Walk in town; boats to the islands.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; tipping isn't expected.
buyTip: Not much; it's about the water.

connections.note: Via Brisbane or by long drive.
